# Steer Positively

Prompt the target behavior instead of the banned one. A prohibition drags
the banned action into attention and half-reads as an invitation; state
what to do so the ban is never spoken.

## Rationale

"Never edit generated files" makes editing generated files more
available. The positive form — "treat everything under `generated/` as
build output; regenerate rather than edit" — lands the instruction
without activating the failure.

A prohibition earns its place only as a hard guardrail phrased no other
way, and then pairs with the positive target so attention lands on what
to do.

Correct: "Write one-line comments that name the invariant."
Incorrect: "Don't write verbose comments."
